capabilities: Embed Jira Cloud issues as tiles via code blocks or standalone pasted issue URLs
Authenticate with Atlassian API tokens stored in Obsidian's SecretStorage
Render custom Jira fields with automatic formatters and a discovery picker
Cache fetched issues with a configurable TTL and offline fallback to stale data
Insert and refresh tiles from palette commands with compact or full display
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins registry; manual install from a cloned repo is required. An earlier OAuth flow was removed; only API-token auth is supported. Targets Atlassian Cloud only, not Server/Data Center.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show current Jira issue details (status, priority, assignee, custom fields) inside a note, so readers must leave the vault or paste stale screenshots.

relations.evidence: Embed live Jira issue tiles in your Obsidian notes via fenced code blocks.

summary: Embeds live Atlassian Jira Cloud issues as rich tiles in notes via fenced jira code blocks or auto-linked issue URLs.
